_note: Tutorials for a fight: the combat bar, whose turn it is and the threatened squares, and non-lethal damage. The same rules as table.json's note; the numbers come from rules/tutorialfacts.py.

steps.title: Build a turn
steps.words: In a fight you build your turn here, then commit it. A turn holds one standard action and one move, or a full attack in place of both, with a swift action and free ones beside. Anything the buttons cannot say, write in the pen.

steps.title: Aim and move
steps.words: Press a foe's name to aim at them. On the Map, press a lit square to move there. Each step joins the plan below the names; drag a step, or use its arrows, to strike first and step away after.

source.literal:
the earlier/later
// arrows on each chip

steps.title: The actions
steps.words: Throw, Coup de grâce, Put out the flames, Tear free and Break free show only while they apply.

buttons.label: Strike
buttons.words: One blow at the target, with the weapon you choose.

buttons.label: Full attack…
buttons.words: Every attack you have, standing where you are.

buttons.label: Ability…
buttons.words: A class or race ability: a standard, full-round or move action.

buttons.label: Swift…
buttons.words: A swift or immediate ability, beside the rest of the turn.

buttons.label: Free…
buttons.words: Free actions, such as starting a rage.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.words: Empties the plan to start the turn again.

steps.title: Declare
steps.words: Declare holds what you choose before the blow: Power Attack or Cleave, and anyone's Fight defensively, Total defense, Feint and Tumble. Each shows its numbers; a grey one says why the planned action cannot carry it. A toggle you declare is named on the button.

source.literal: the planned action cannot carry it, is greyed with

buttons.label: With the blow
buttons.words: Toggles that ride every attack you stage, such as Power Attack.

buttons.label: As the action
buttons.words: An action of its own: Vital Strike, Cleave, Total defense, Feint.

buttons.label: With the move
buttons.words: Tumble: an Acrobatics roll so the move past foes provokes nothing.

steps.title: Commit or pass
steps.words: Committing with nothing planned is refused, so you never pass by accident.

source.literal: Commit turn with nothing planned is not a pass.

buttons.label: Commit turn
buttons.words: Carries out the plan in its order; then the others act.

buttons.label: End turn
buttons.words: Passes, using nothing; the plan is put away.

steps.title: What the rules hold you to
steps.words: A blow at someone out of reach is refused, and says the square to move to first. Drinking a potion is your standard action, and it provokes an attack from anyone who threatens you.

source.literal: # --- a drink in a fight: a standard action that provokes

steps.title: Who goes when
steps.words: Everyone rolled for initiative when the fight began, and acts in that order each round. The bar says whose turn it is; the others act after you commit or end yours. In the scene, at the side, lists the order.

source.literal: // Turn order, only while a fight is on.

steps.title: Threatened squares
steps.words: A hatched square is one a foe threatens. Leaving one provokes an attack of opportunity. Press a square before you move: the line under the board says how far it is, who threatens it and whether going there provokes.

steps.title: Safe and risky
steps.words: On your turn the squares you can reach are lit in two colours: moves that are safe, and moves that provoke. The Key names both.

steps.title: Knocked out, not killed
steps.words: Fists and saps deal non-lethal damage, and so does a lethal weapon pulled at a cost to hit: say so in the pen. When it reaches someone's hit points they are staggered; past them, they drop. It never kills.

source.literal: 1e: at your current hit points you are staggered, past them you are unconscious.

steps.title: Seeing it
steps.words: Press someone on the Map and the line under the board shows their non-lethal damage beside their hit points. It heals by the hour.

steps.title: A blow at the helpless
steps.words: A coup de grâce struck to subdue is a Fortitude save or out cold for {knockout_dice} hours, never death. Struck to kill, a failed save is death.

source.literal: but a failure is never death
